meta.name: review-skill
meta.description: This skill should be invoked by a review orchestrator (e.g. `reviewer:self-review`) to review SKILL.md files for quality, frontmatter correctness, and convention compliance, and to check the impact of a change on skills across the project.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审查技能文件,确保质量与规范合规
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你负责维护技能库,需要统一文件质量
copy.tagline_en: Review skill files for quality and convention compliance
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain skill files and need quality control

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会审查技能文件（SKILL.md）：检查文件头格式与正文质量、规范符合度，验证引用文件和 `$ARGUMENTS` 用法；检查改动对其他技能的影响，找失效引用和过期内容，按固定格式输出报告。
howto.when: 当审查编排器（如 `reviewer:self-review`）传入要审查的文件路径时触发；也适用于你直接要求审查某技能文件或检查改动的影响时。

say.text: 审查一下 skills/math/SKILL.md 这个文件
say.note: 按清单检查该文件质量和引用

say.text: 我改了三个技能，检查会影响哪些其他技能
say.note: 跨项目找出失效引用和过期内容

say.text: 用默认规则审查项目里全部技能
say.note: 没有传入路径时，检查所有技能

howto.what_en: Claude reviews SKILL.md files: parses frontmatter/body, verifies references and `$ARGUMENTS` usage, then checks repo-wide impact, flagging stale refs and broken links. Output follows reviewer-framework.
howto.when_en: Triggered by a review orchestrator when it passes focus paths; also when a user asks to review a SKILL.md file or check change impact on project skills.

say_en.note: Checks that file's quality and references

say_en.text: I changed three skills, check what else is affected
say_en.note: Finds stale refs and outdated content project-wide

say_en.text: Review all skills in the project with default rules
say_en.note: With no focus paths, checks every skill
